name: ops
description: Operations and site reliability: incident response with SEV1 to SEV4 severities and blameless postmortems, root cause analysis with 5 Whys, systematic debugging with git bisect, log search in Elastic, Kibana or OpenSearch with a grep and jq fallback, tool-independent log analysis, runbooks, on-call handoffs, SLOs with error budgets and burn-rate alerts, capacity planning for peaks and growth, and chaos experiments with a bounded blast radius. Proposes every command that changes a system and waits for the person's approval.
